**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is planning a trip to Miami later in the year.  
[FACT] User earned 10,000 miles on their Delta SkyMiles card after taking a round-trip flight from Boston to Atlanta.  
[PREFERENCE] User is flexible with their travel dates.  
[EVENT] User is considering redeeming their Delta SkyMiles for a free trip to Miami.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] One-way economy flights within the continental United States typically require 5,000-10,000 miles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Round-trip economy flights within the continental United States typically require 10,000-20,000 miles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User might be able to redeem a one-way economy flight or a round-trip economy flight with some flexibility in travel dates.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended checking Delta's award chart and using their award calendar tool.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Steps to use Delta's award calendar tool:  
1. Log in to Delta SkyMiles account and go to "Book a Flight" page.  
2. Select "Shop with Miles" and enter travel dates and route (BOS to MIA).  
3. Click on "Award Calendar" button to see available award flights.  
4. Filter results by "Miles" to see the lowest redemption options.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested looking for flights on off-peak days (e.g., Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Saturdays) or during off-peak seasons (e.g., mid-January to mid-March).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User can also set up price alerts on Delta's website or use third-party tools like ExpertFlyer or Google Flights.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User can use miles to book flights on Delta's partner airlines, such as LATAM, but not on American Airlines.  
[FACT] User had a recent experience with American Airlines, mentioning a terrible in-flight entertainment system on a flight from New York to Los Angeles on February 10th.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Delta and American Airlines are not airline partners, so Delta SkyMiles cannot be redeemed on American Airlines flights.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested exploring American Airlines' AAdvantage program for potential better deals.
